about: The graduale of the formulary “Transfiguration of Our Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: You surpass the sons of men in beauty; grace has been poured out upon Your lips. My heart has poured forth a noble word; I recite my works to the King.

w001.explanation: Speciósus is a positive adjective meaning beautiful. Præ supplies the comparison with the sons of men. The address leaves “You are” unexpressed.

w012.explanation: The heart is pictured as pouring out words. The image presents the speaker’s inward thought becoming an utterance.

w019.explanation: Ópera is plural: the speaker’s works or compositions. In this declaration to the King, it names what the speaker recites.
